kept.title: Potential breaking change in File.read() removing BOM and EOL escape
kept.explanation: The change removes automatic escaping of BOM and Windows line endings in `File.prototype.read` by deleting calls to `escapeContent`. This breaks existing behavior where reading files automatically normalized line endings and removed BOMs.
kept.suggestion: Restore escaping of BOM and EOL in `File.prototype.read` if `options.escape` is true, or document the breaking change clearly.
kept.failureAfterChange: Reading a file with BOM or Windows CRLF line endings now returns raw content with BOM and CRLFs instead of normalized content.

kept.title: Potential breaking change in File.readSync() removing BOM and EOL escape
kept.explanation: Similar to `read()`, the `readSync()` method no longer automatically escapes BOM and Windows line endings, which breaks compatibility with code expecting normalized content upon synchronous read.
kept.suggestion: Restore the escaping logic in `readSync()` method or provide an option to opt-in.
kept.failureAfterChange: Synchronous reading of files with BOM or CRLF line endings returns raw content instead of normalized content.

verdicts.reason: The finding correctly identifies that the change removes the automatic escaping of BOM and EOL in File.read(), which is a breaking change in behavior as the new code returns raw content instead of normalized content.

The finding correctly identifies that the change removes automatic escaping of BOM and EOL in File.readSync(), leading to a breaking change where the synchronous read returns raw content instead of the previously normalized content.
